title: Nicknames: the Amazing June Gardner and Gentleman June Gardner
summary: How he got the title the Amazing and why his album was named Gentleman June Gardner.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: I saw something where it said you were referred to as the Amazing June Gardner.

Yeah a friend of mine, his name was James Russell, they called him Stinky. That was a title that he put on me. We used to give concerts with the big bands. And he used to say, man I need a title in front of your name. I'm going to start calling you the Amazing. So that and then I had an album that was out many years ago on NOLA Records. And it was Gentleman June Gardner because a lot of the time people would say, I would give my name to guys. Like you said, June let me your number. And their wives would find my name, June. And they would call and say, let me speak to this blah, blah, blah.
So maybe June was a woman? Yeah.

And my wife would say, you want to speak to my husband? He's a man. You know, this kind of thing. So the albums, they rather, they didn't put no pictures on the album at that particular time when my album came out. So they put Gentleman June Gardner on it. So that's the reason. They let people know that it was a man. You know, but I used to go through some changes where they'd give people my number and the ladies would take it the wrong way.
Okay, well we got that cleared up. Now we know why you called Gentleman. I've been called many things.
